title: zanthoxylum pterota
intro: Zanthoxylum pterota, commonly known as the Chinese pepper tree or Japanese pepper, is a species of plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Zanthoxylum pterota include relieving pain, reducing fever, and treating respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis.
